contributions.detail: 13 rows sum to 14,343.74. Cover line 1 (over-$50 contributions, the anchor named by the addendum) reads 14,368.74 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns; the LAST REPORT column reads N/A, so this is the only report of the cycle and the two scopes coincide. Residual = exactly 25.00, which is exactly the figure the filer wrote on cover line 2 (the $50.00-or-less aggregate, 25). The cause is FILER ARITHMETIC: line 1 as written evidently already contains the 25.00 small-donor aggregate that line 2 also reports, i.e. line 1 is the filer's TOTAL contributions rather than the over-$50 subtotal. Scoring against line1+line2 (14,393.74) is worse, not better. Every amount was re-read in 600 dpi column crops and every one is confirmed; no single row is 25.00 short and no row is missing (13 names, 13 amounts, the grid below row 13 is blank). The rows are published verbatim; the stated total is NOT recomputed. Corroboration that the transcription itself is sound: the same filer's Form B sums to 14,368.74 EXACTLY against cover line 3.

Contributions as the filer stated them (14,368.74) minus expenses (14,368.74) = 0, consistent with a dash meaning nothing left. LAST REPORT column reads 'N/A' on lines 1-3, so there is no prior filing to chain to and no swapped-cover risk.
